key_concepts: Ecosystems are composed of biotic and abiotic factors
A species is a group of similar organisms capable of interbreeding
A population is a group of individuals of the same species
A community is an interacting group of various species in a common location
Taxonomic ranks include species, genus, family, order, class, phylum/division, kingdom, an
Kingdom Plantae includes multicellular photosynthetic organisms such as corn, gumamela, an
Order Carnivora includes flesh-eating organisms such as tigers and lions
Tigers and lions are in the same genus Panthera but different species
Biodiversity has three levels: ecosystem diversity, genetic diversity, and species diversi
Tropical rainforests have higher biodiversity than deserts
High biodiversity helps maintain ecosystem stability
Classifying organisms helps organize and understand the diversity of life
